title: Outcomes Testing and Management Information
summary: Building outcome testing and management information that show whether customers are being well served, and acting on what the data reveals.
contentGaps: Written as part of a programme: Aim and Purpose is the module's one-line description; audience, prior knowledge and core reading come from the programme

sections.Aim and Purpose: Building outcome testing and management information that show whether customers are being well served, and acting on what the data reveals.
Learning Objectives: Design outcome metrics across products, value, understanding and support
Apply outcome testing and data analysis to identify harm
Use management information to drive action rather than reassurance
Syllabus: Outcome metrics and indicators of customer harm
Testing methods: data analysis, mystery shopping and file reviews
Data quality and segmentation by customer group
Data exercise: analysing a firm's outcomes data
Intended Audience: Compliance, conduct risk and consumer outcome specialists
Product, marketing, pricing and customer service managers
Senior managers and business-line owners accountable for retail customer outcomes
sections.Useful Prior Knowledge and Experience: Some experience of compliance, product or customer-facing work in a retail financial services firm is helpful. No specialist conduct background is required.
Core Reading: G20/OECD High-Level Principles on Financial Consumer Protection (2022)
World Bank, Good Practices for Financial Consumer Protection (2017)
FSB, Strengthening Governance Frameworks to Mitigate Misconduct Risk: A Toolkit for Firms and Supervisors (2018)
